reviews.author: Yang-Yang-yy
reviews.body:
The implementation is well structured, and all 132 repository tests passed locally.

I found one blocking failure path in `domains/pet_care/feeder.py` around the `feeder.read_state()` preflight: it runs before the core monitoring workflow, but only `ConnectionError` and `KeyError` are caught. A realistic adapter timeout or I/O failure therefore propagates and prevents the Pet Care assessment, simulated owner alert, and event record from completing. I reproduced this with a feeder whose `read_state()` raises `TimeoutError`.

Please treat feeder read failures or malformed returned state as `UNAVAILABLE`, allowing core monitoring and notification to continue, and add a regression test with a timeout-raising feeder stub.

Non-blocking:
- Please add the relevant Jira issue key/link to the PR title or Development section as required by `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- Resetting the UI produces a Streamlit warning because `pet_feed_grams` is set through Session State while the widget also specifies `value=20`.

reviews.author: Yang-Yang-yy
reviews.body:
Re-reviewed after commits `ce5a131` and `dd5a7e2`. The feeder timeout and malformed-state paths now report `UNAVAILABLE` while core monitoring, the simulated owner alert, and event recording continue. The Streamlit reset warning is resolved, and the Jira references are included.

I reran all 11 Pet Care Sprint 2 tests and the complete 134-test repository suite locally; all passed. Approved.
